d: Winter is closing in, and the miners are running out of time to strike gold! With massive washplants to keep running, machinery threatening to break down and new ground waiting to be mined, every hour counts in the Klondike. Parker Schnabel pushes his operation to keep pace, Tony Beets takes on challenges with his massive dredge, and Todd Hoffman's crew faces mounting pressure to meet its gold targets. As the cold sets in and the season approaches its end, the race is on to make every last day count. Will the miners strike it rich before winter takes over?
